images.name: era2-court
images.prompt: top-down view of a retro 8-bit NES sports arena floor, dark teal square floor tiles with thin black grout lines, flat and simple, empty, no players, no text
images.how: quantized pixel by pixel to the nearest NES colour, every entry as bright as the ball held back (luma under 0.8); then the two light-grey boxes that read as a 3 beside each paddle and the pitch's own halfway line painted back to the floor colour (PAINT_OUT, item 1191)
images.verdict: drawn by era 2 (src/eras/era2-nes.js, embedded there as a data: URI)
